# Visit Golden

> > Official tourism guide for Golden, Colorado featuring Red Rocks concert planning, local dining, pet-friendly activities, and downtown shopping experiences.

Visit Golden is the destination marketing organization for Golden, Colorado, showcasing the city's proximity to Red Rocks Amphitheatre, historic downtown attractions like the Foothills Art Center and Astor House, and local businesses including The Golden Mill and Silver Horse. The site promotes Golden as a welcoming mountain town with unique shopping, dining, and outdoor experiences.

## Key Topics

- Red Rocks Amphitheatre
- Yoga on the Rocks
- Film on the Rocks
- Downtown Golden shopping
- Pet-friendly tourism
- Local restaurants and dining
- The Golden Mill
- Foothills Art Center
- Astor House Museum
- Concert planning and tailgating
- Small Business Saturday
- Pre-concert activities
- Historic Golden attractions
- Mountain town experiences
